affected_area.description: Best guess at the component, service or layer involved, for example 'frontend/auth', 'API', 'CI pipeline' or 'unknown'.

actionable.description: Whether the request has enough information to act on.

needs_clarification.description: True when the request is ambiguous, contradictory or missing essentials. The questions go in questions.

questions.description: Specific clarifying questions. Empty unless needs_clarification is true.

summary.description: One-sentence restatement of the work item.
